newsitem.title: UK: European mill buyers shy in dull cotton amrkets.
newsitem.headline: European mill buyers shy in dull cotton amrkets.

text.p: Both mill buyers and trade sellers were wary of fresh business in dull European raw cotton markets.

With the exception of US prices, offering rates generally failed to reflect fully Thursday's decline in New York futures. Those with current crop supplies in hand were reluctant to discount offers, given rather tenuous supply prospects in coming months.

The New York fall highlighted a possibility that US cotton may soon compete effectively with more traditional growths on offer in Europe. For now, however, most spinners show only lukewarm interest in US styles, for lack of big enough discount to justify altering usual blends.
